_help: Seeds you control. Every entry is re-checked on each run: the page must load, robots.txt must allow it, 'must_contain' must be on the page, and a contact_email is only used if it is written on contact_source_url (for YouTube: labelled as a business contact in the channel's latest video descriptions). Each entry also records what a person checked: source_type, last_checked, eligibility (status + verified requirements + what is still uncertain) and why Ringshift fits. Only enabled entries with eligibility 'meets' or 'likely' are used; 'uncertain' ones are held. Sources looked at and turned down go in 'excluded' so nobody re-adds them by mistake. See outreach/README.md.

youtube_channels.name: I Dream of Indie Games
youtube_channels.fit: Published a video on upcoming indie puzzle games (2026-03-04) and covers small indie games; a browser puzzle game with a free demo matches what the channel features.

verified: Video '10 Upcoming Indie Puzzle Games Releasing in 2026' (uploaded 2026-03-04) is about indie puzzle games.
That video's description lists a 'Business Inquiries' address written out in full.
uncertain: No published submission policy, so coverage of free browser games is not confirmed.
Subscriber count was not checked (no API key in the research session); it may be larger than a small channel.

youtube_channels.about: Indie games channel; covers upcoming indie puzzle games.

curators.name: Thinky Games
curators.fit: Site dedicated to puzzle ('thinky') games; Ringshift is a logic puzzle game.

verified: Its About page links forms for suggesting a game.

curators.notes: Puzzle-game site. Its About page links forms for suggesting a game; the press address on that page is obfuscated, so no email is used unless you add one with add-contact. Its YouTube channel is listed as an alias so the same organisation is never contacted twice.

curators.name: Coolmath Games
curators.fit: Browser-game site that licenses HTML5 'thinking' games (logic, strategy, problem solving); Ringshift is an HTML5 logic puzzle in one file with no ads, no tracking and no name entry.

verified: The game must be HTML5 (no plugins).
The game must be a 'thinking' game requiring logic, strategy and/or problem solving; it need not contain math.
No violence or foul language; free of advertising; no external links; no stats counter reporting back; name entry disabled.
Non-exclusive licence: the game can stay on other sites and stores. Coolmath's SDK is added only after acceptance.
The version shown does not have to meet every requirement yet.
uncertain: The demo has one external link (a 'Wishlist on Steam' button pointing at the Steam front page) that would have to be removed for a licence.
The application itself is a Google Form linked from the page; its fields were not inspected.

curators.notes: Browser games for players who like logic and problem solving. Submission page for developers; licensing is decided by their review.

curators.name: CrazyGames
curators.fit: Large free browser-game portal with a no-integration 'Basic Launch' for web games; Ringshift is a small single-file HTML game with no ads or logins.

verified: Games are submitted through the Developer Portal (developer.crazygames.com).
Basic Launch needs no CrazyGames customisation; the SDK is optional for Basic Launch and required only for Full Launch.
Basic Launch limits: initial download up to 50 MB, total up to 250 MB (50 MB without SDK), at most 1,500 files; basic visual QA; PEGI 12.
Basic Launch: no external ads and no external login options.
A description, controls and cover images/videos must be provided.
uncertain: Acceptance depends on their QA review.
Cover images and a video must be prepared before uploading.
Their pages state no policy on AI-assisted development; none was found.

curators.notes: Free browser-game portal. Route is a developer-portal upload, not an email.

curators.name: Alpha Beta Gamer
curators.fit: Features indie games that are in development and free to try; Ringshift is in development with a free browser demo.

verified: Games featured on the website must be in development (alpha, beta or demo).
Sign-ups or downloads must be free to the public.
Submissions go to the e-mail address written on the Game Submissions page; every submission is read, not every one is featured or answered.

curators.notes: Indie games in alpha, beta and demo. Its YouTube channel is listed as an alias so the same organisation is never contacted twice.

curators.name: Overlooked.gg
curators.fit: Weekly reviews of indie games that deserve more attention; route verified, but its model is built around games it buys.

verified: Submissions are open through a 'Submit a Game' form (store link, developer, contact email, core content loop).
Every reviewed game is bought by the team at full price; no developer keys or sponsored placements.
uncertain: Ringshift has no store page or price yet; whether a free browser demo can be reviewed is not stated.
Their rating weighs value against price, which a free demo cannot be judged on.

curators.notes: Held until Ringshift has a store page (e.g. itch.io or Steam). Enable it then, after re-checking the request page.

excluded.name: Playlin
excluded.reason: Directory of daily web games only ('Built a daily web game? Submit it'); Ringshift has no daily mode.

excluded.name: Games Y'all
excluded.reason: Monthly in-person meetup; its game-submission rules (incl. the AI-generated-assets policy on moha.wiki) could not be read, so compliance cannot be demonstrated. Not eligible until verified.

excluded.name: Poki
excluded.reason: Closed beta, hand-picked; expects web exclusivity and mandatory Poki SDK. Ringshift is already on the open web (GitHub Pages).

excluded.name: Thinky Third Thursday (Draknek & Friends)
excluded.reason: Relevant and active (October 2026 edition, includes free browser games) but publishes no submission address or form.

excluded.name: Warp Door
excluded.reason: General editors' address on its About page, but no statement that it takes submissions and no recent activity could be confirmed.

excluded.name: Turn Based Lovers
excluded.reason: Covers turn-based RPG and strategy games only; submission address is obfuscated.

excluded.name: Draknek New Voices Puzzle Grant
excluded.reason: Grant, not coverage; applications closed on 2026-09-27.

excluded.name: player.gg
excluded.reason: Listing service built around Steam App IDs and sign-ups, not a creator or curator contact route.
